column1: # The index examples/typst-order.qmd prints in a Typst render (M100).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. The row shape is the one
# Physical pages, from the source's `set page` rules, with the pattern, the
# page counter, the text the page prints, and the class and value of a
# locator opening there. Class order: lower roman (lr), upper roman (ur),
# arabic (ar), lower letters (ll), upper letters (ul), other (ot).
#   page 11  a function of the counter, 2: f2        ot 2
#   page 13  none, the physical page: 13             ar 13
#   pages 22 to 28  `1`, counter 1 to 7: ar 1 to ar 7
#   page 38  `1`    1   the index, whose footer prints `1`
# A range spans values only where its two ends have one class and its closing
# value is greater than its opening value. A range whose two ends print one
#   ash      ur 3 on page 1, lr 2 on page 3: lower roman first
#   beech    ar 3 on page 2, ur 2 on page 4: upper roman first
#   cedar    ll 2 on page 5, ar 1 on page 10: arabic first
#   dogwood  ul 4 on page 6, ll 3 on page 8: lower letters first
#   elder    ot 2 on page 7, ul 1 on page 9: upper letters first
#   fig      ot 2 on page 11, ar 40 on page 12: arabic first
#   gorse    ar 40 on page 12, ar 13 on page 13 (no numbering): 13 first
#   hazel    ar 3 on page 2, ar 1 on page 10 after a reset: 1 first
#   iris     ar 2 printing `2` on page 14 and `(2)` on page 15: two texts,
#   juniper  a single mark and a range opening on page 16, ar 4; the range
#            closes on lr 1, so it spans nothing: the single mark first
#   kale     a range ar 2 to ar 4 on pages 17 to 19 spans 2, 3 and 4; ar 3 on
#            page 2 is spanned and prints nothing; ll 3 on page 18 is not
#   lime     a range ar 5 to ar 7 on pages 20 to 21; ar 5 on page 26 and the
#            principal ar 7 on page 28 are spanned and print nothing
#   maple    a range ar 1 to ar 3 on pages 22 to 24; a range printing `2` at
#            both ends, pages 29 to 33, is a single mark on ar 2, spanned
#   nutmeg   a range printing `2` at both ends, pages 14 to 17, and a mark
#            printing `2` on page 23: one locator, linked to page 14
#   oak      ar 4 on page 25; a range ar 6 to ar 2, pages 27 to 33, spans
#   pine     a range ar 2 to ll 5, pages 23 to 34, spans nothing; ar 3 on page
#            24 prints: the range first, by value
#   quince   ranges ar 1 to 6 (pages 22-27), ar 2 to 4 (29-30) and ar 5 to 8
#            (31-32): the second nests in the first and the third overlaps
#   rowan    a range ar 2 to ar 2, pages 14 to 15, printing `2–(2)`, spans
#            nothing; ar 2 on page 17 prints: the range first, by page
#   sage     ar 2 on page 33, the principal ll 9 `i` on page 35, lr 1 `i` on
#            page 36: order lr `i`, ar 2, ll `i`; the two `i` print once, at
#            the place of lr `i`, bold, linked to page 35
#   thyme    ll 9 `i` on page 35, lr 1 `i` on page 36 and a range lr 1 to lr 3
#            on pages 36 to 37: the lr `i` is spanned and prints nothing, so
#            the ll `i` is not merged with it and prints
